Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile. Were assembling a short mutual action plan so procurement and security can sign off. High level asks from our side: a) SOC 2 evidence package (latest report + control owner mapping), b) a completed SIG/CAIQ matrix or equivalent, c) draft DPA with our standard redlines applied, and d) clarification on data retention and deletion SLA for KV/cache and long-term audit logs.

Goal: finish evaluation and get to PO within 4 weeks. Can Redwood supply a MAP and the artifacts above? If you can share a proposed timeline and point people internally, Ill align our Security and Procurement owners.

Best,
Lisa Carter
CISO (acting)
Blue Harbor Financial

--- Message 2/4 ---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Lisa — thanks, appreciate the crisp ask. Im attaching a one-page MAP that maps milestones to owners, plus a redacted SIG workbook with high-level answers and a DPA redline stub from our legal team. Short summary below; full artifacts attached.

Quick summary (draft):
- Week 0 (today): Share MAP, draft SIG responses, DPA redline stub. Owners: Jonas (sales), Neha (security), Kimberly (legal).
- Week 1: Security walkthrough (live call) to go over SIG clarifications + SOC 2 control mapping.
- Week 2: SOC 2 evidence package delivered (nondisclosable items redacted), legal to exchange DPA comments.
- Week 3: Finalize DPA / countersign path.
- Week 4: Procurement PO issuance and onboarding kickoff.

Data residency & retention (initial proposal):
- Audit logs (access/change/audit): retained 7 years by default, exportable on request.
- Long-term object store/backups (customer data): configurable by region (US / EU), default US.
- KV cache (model session cache / prefix cache): TTL default 24h; option to set 0h for strict ephemeral mode (no persistence).
- Deletion SLA: deletion/obfuscation requests executed within 30 calendar days; immediate short-term cache purge for in-flight sessions.

Attachments (stubs): rw_MAP_blueharbor_draft.md (MAP outline), redacted_sig_matrix.xlsx (SIG high-level answers), redline_dpa_v1.pdf (legal stub).

Neha/Kim: can you review the proposed retention items below and flag anything we should tighten before I send the MAP as a doc link to Lisa?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Jonas — this is helpful, thanks. A few follow-ups from our Security and Procurement teams after reviewing the attachments:
1) SOC 2 evidence: can you confirm whether the control owner mapping includes contact points for control owners (name/email) for the technical controls? Our Security team needs someone for a short control interview.
2) SIG/CAIQ: wed like the full worksheet if possible; the redacted version is fine for public answers but well need the complete matrix under NDA before the walkthrough.
3) DPA: we have three standard asks: (a) explicit EU data residency option, (b) a 30-day deletion SLA is acceptable but needs a contractual escrowing step for deletion proof (audit log showing delete), (c) limits on subprocessor onboarding (30-day notice + right to object).
4) Retention: clarify the difference between audit logs (7 years) and data store backups (we prefer 90 days by default, longer by exception). Also confirm encryption-at-rest key management (do you support customer-managed keys (CMK) / KMS integrations?).

Procurement: please prepare DocuSign routing for DPA once legal aligns. If Redwood can provide a first countersigned DPA within Week 2 window, that keeps us on the Week 4 PO path.

Cheers,
Lisa

--- Message 4/4 ---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@blueharbor.com>, Blue Harbor Procurement <procurement@blueharbor.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-01-18 14:02 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + security gating for pilot

Lisa / Procurement — thanks for the clarity. Internal notes and next steps below; Ill also update the MAP doc and push a fresh link by end of day.

Responses / commitments:
- SOC 2 control interviews: we can provide control owner contact points for the technical controls (Neha will be primary for infra controls; Ive included her on this thread). We can schedule 45-minute interviews in Week 1.
- SIG/CAIQ full workbook: we can share under NDA. Suggest we exchange an NDA link before exposing the full matrix; Ill coordinate with Kimberly for a quick mutual NDA if needed.
- DPA redlines: Kimberly has reviewed the redline (attached). On the three asks you flagged:
  a) EU residency: Redwood supports EU-hosted datasets and private-region deploys; well commit to EU residency for Blue Harbor production data and will document the region in the DPA Annex.
  b) Deletion SLA & proof: well commit contractually to a 30-calendar-day deletion SLA. We can provide deletion proof via an audit log extract (signed timestamp + deletion job id) as part of the DPA Annex.
  c) Subprocessors: we propose 30-day notice for new subprocessors with an objection window; where objections are raised well provide mitigation options (e.g., data residency isolation, alternate subprocessors).
- Retention: default audit log retention 7 years (exportable). Backup retention default 90 days; customers can request extended windows for an agreed fee and SLA.
- KMS/CMK: we support cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and can offer an HSM-backed option for enterprise Private deployments; will enumerate options in the DPA.

Timing / MAP update:
- Today (EOD): push updated MAP with the above commitments + updated attachments (rw_MAP_blueharbor_v2.md).
- Mon (Week 1): schedule SIG walkthrough + SOC 2 control interview (Neha to propose slots).
- End Week 2: exchange and agree DPA redline, sign NDA if required.
- Week 3: finalize DPA + countersign path.
- Week 4: PO issuance and kickoff.

Attachments referenced: rw_MAP_blueharbor_draft.md (map outline), redacted_sig_matrix.xlsx (redacted answers), redline_dpa_v1.pdf (legal comments). Ive added a short appendix in the MAP that includes the deletion-proof format (audit log slice sample) and an example subprocessor notice workflow.

Kimberly/Neha: please confirm the NDA approach (do we route our standard mutual NDA or will Blue Harbor provide one?).

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if Procurement wants to triage the DocuSign routing.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
